title: Zone On-Time Delivery SLA & Escalation Thresholds
section_heading: 1. Minimum On-Time Delivery Target & Breach Cap (OPS-SLA-95)
text: Under Operational Policy OPS-SLA-95, every manufacturing and clinical zone must maintain a minimum quarterly On-Time Delivery (OTD) rate of 95.0% and no more than 5 quarterly SLA breaches. Any zone falling below 95.0% OTD or exceeding 5 SLA breaches is classified as Red-Tier Non-Compliant and must submit a Root-Cause Corrective Action Plan (CAPA) within 5 business days.

title: Zone On-Time Delivery SLA & Escalation Thresholds
section_heading: 2. Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) Ceiling & Automation Target (OPS-MTTR-6H)
text: Control OPS-MTTR-6H establishes a maximum Mean Time To Repair (mean_repair_hours) ceiling of 6.0 hours for automated diagnostic and robotics lines, alongside a target workflow automation coverage of at least 80.0%. Zones exceeding 6.0 repair hours require an immediate field-engineering dispatch audit.

title: Quarterly OPEX Variance Cap & CFO Freeze Protocol
section_heading: 1. OPEX Variance Thresholds & Discretionary Spend Freeze (FIN-CAP-8PCT)
text: Under Financial Governance Policy FIN-CAP-8PCT, any operating zone whose quarterly OPEX variance (opex_variance_pct) exceeds 8.0% above budget triggers a mandatory CFO Discretionary Spend Freeze and requires Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) executive approval before releasing new contractor or cloud compute requisitions. Variances between 3.0% and 8.0% require a VP Finance variance memo.

title: Quarterly OPEX Variance Cap & CFO Freeze Protocol
section_heading: 2. Minimum Gross Margin & Cloud AI Spend Allocation (FIN-GM-58)
text: Directive FIN-GM-58 requires operating zones to sustain a minimum quarterly gross margin of 58.0% and caps quarterly cloud AI inference and training expenditure at EUR 180,000 per zone unless a high-volume workload waiver is countersigned.

title: Tier-1 Supplier Uptime SLA & Penalty Rebate Schedule
text: Clause VND-SLA-995 mandates a minimum 99.5% quarterly availability (uptime_pct) across all Tier-1 production suppliers. Suppliers recording uptime between 99.0% and 99.49% incur a 5.0% annual contract penalty rebate. Suppliers falling below 99.0% uptime or recording 3 or more critical incidents in a quarter incur a 12.0% annual contract penalty rebate and formal vendor probation.

title: Tier-1 Supplier Uptime SLA & Penalty Rebate Schedule
text: Under Schedule VND-BOARD-500K, any Tier-1 supplier contract with an annual contract value (annual_contract_eur) of EUR 500,000 or higher requires semi-annual resilience auditing and dual sign-off from the VP of Procurement and Chief Information Security Officer.

title: Relational Data Warehouse Freshness & Null-Ratio Gate
section_heading: 1. Pre-Query Freshness SLA & Stale Partition Blocking (DQA-FRESH-24H)
text: Standard DQA-FRESH-24H requires the Data Quality Gate to inspect table refresh timestamps (refreshed_at_utc) prior to executing any SQL analytics or hybrid RAG synthesis. Operational and financial KPI tables have a warning threshold of 12.0 hours and a hard blocking ceiling of 24.0 hours; legacy supply backlog partitions have a hard blocking ceiling of 48.0 hours. Any query targeting a table in blocked_stale status must be rejected before SQL execution.

title: Relational Data Warehouse Freshness & Null-Ratio Gate
text: Control DQA-NULL-5PCT enforces strict relational schema contracts: every required column must exist, table row counts must fall within [min_rows, max_rows], and the maximum observed column null ratio must not exceed 5.0% (0.05). Violations transition the table to blocked_contract status.

title: Read-Only Parameterized SQL & AST Security Policy
section_heading: 1. AST Read-Only Validation & Mutating Keyword Ban (SQL-AST-RO)
text: Security Policy SQL-AST-RO prohibits unconstrained free-text LLM SQL execution. Every generated query must map to an approved parameterized SELECT template, bind arguments exclusively via SQLite parameter placeholders (:param), and pass AST token inspection blocking INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, ALTER, ATTACH, PRAGMA, and multi-statement semicolons.

title: Read-Only Parameterized SQL & AST Security Policy
text: Under Control NUM-PARITY-100, every numeric, currency, or percentage token present in a drafted executive summary must be extracted and verified against the exact SQL result set or retrieved policy passage within a relative tolerance of 1e-2 (0.01). Any unverified number blocks automatic release.

title: Digest-Bound Executive Sign-Off & Snapshot Invalidation
text: Standard HITL-STATE-4 governs decision-support briefs through a deterministic state machine: DRAFT -> PENDING_APPROVAL -> APPROVED or REJECTED. Transitions are logged in an append-only SQLite audit trail with actor identity, UTC timestamp, and bound SHA-256 evidence digest.

title: Digest-Bound Executive Sign-Off & Snapshot Invalidation
section_heading: 2. Composite Evidence SHA-256 Binding & Drift Invalidation (HITL-DRIFT-SHA)
text: Control HITL-DRIFT-SHA binds every human approval to SHA256(normalized_question || sql_snapshot_sha256 || sorted_passage_sha256s || answer_sha256). If an underlying SQL table refresh or SOP revision changes the snapshot hash, digest verification automatically transitions the workflow from APPROVED to REJECTED with reason invalidated_by_data_drift.

title: Build-vs-Adopt Decision Matrix for Enterprise AI Systems
section_heading: 1. When to Adopt Commodity SaaS vs Build Governed Hybrid Copilot (ARCH-BVA-01)
text: Framework ARCH-BVA-01 establishes the enterprise Build-vs-Adopt rule: commodity document search with non-financial data should adopt off-the-shelf SaaS assistants, whereas workflows combining regulated relational KPIs, strict numerical parity (100% grounding), pre-query data freshness gates, and cryptographic HITL audit trails require building a governed hybrid semantic layer.

title: Build-vs-Adopt Decision Matrix for Enterprise AI Systems
text: Target ARCH-COST-20MS specifies that deterministic template-routed SQL and local hybrid retrieval must execute in under 25 milliseconds on CPU while reducing external LLM token consumption by at least 75.0% compared to unconstrained schema-stuffing prompt-to-SQL agents.

title: Cross-Region Telemetry Retention & Anonymization Standard
section_heading: 1. Sovereign EU Warehouse Residency & 90-Day Audit Retention (GDPR-WH-90D)
text: Under Policy GDPR-WH-90D, all European operational and financial warehouse snapshots must reside in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) with query audit logs retained for 90 calendar days and employee operator identifiers pseudonymized before analytics export.

title: Cross-Region Telemetry Retention & Anonymization Standard
section_heading: 2. Right to Erasure & Snapshot Purge SLA (GDPR-PURGE-14D)
text: Control GDPR-PURGE-14D requires purging revoked personal identifiers across relational tables, FTS5 search indices, and cached workflow snapshots within 14 calendar days of a verified GDPR Article 17 request.
